edges.reason: msg.sender is used as mint recipient and as the payer for SMOL tiers in mintNFT
block.timestamp gates _mintedBeforeReveal and startingIndexBlock assignment in mintNFT
block.timestamp is compared to SALE_START_TIMESTAMP to allow price lookup
withdraw is protected by the onlyOwner modifier referencing _owner
msg.sender is compared against the stored owner in onlyOwner and Ownable
_treasury is the recipient argument of the SMOL transferFrom payment
mintNFT performs an external ERC20 transferFrom call on the untrusted SMOL token before/while minting
mintNFT delegates minting to the internal _safeMint function
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which performs the receiver callback
Recipient contract onERC721Received is invoked via low level functionCall, allowing reentrancy into minting flows
withdraw transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender
msg.sender is the recipient of the native ETH transfer in withdraw
changeName calls the external TING ERC20 burn which can execute arbitrary code before state of the name mapping is consistent
_tingAddress is the token contract target of the burn call
_smolAddress is the token contract target of the transferFrom call
numberOfNfts participates in SafeMath multiplication against msg.value in mintNFT
tokenId drives the ownerOf lookup that authorizes the caller in changeName
tokenId is used inside the arithmetic that builds the token metadata URI
newName flows into validation, reservation and storage as the new token name
newName is the string analyzed by validateName
newOwner is validated and stored into the _owner state variable in transferOwnership
local balance captures address(this).balance and is forwarded to the transfer
currentSupply derived from totalSupply drives the tier branching in getNFTPrice
startingIndexBlock is the seed used for the blockhash randomness in finalizeStartingIndex
finalizeStartingIndex computes and stores startingIndex
changeName writes the new name into the _tokenName mapping
changeName toggles the _nameReserved mapping for old and new names
setBaseTokenURI is onlyOwner and writes the baseTokenURI state variable
_owner is checked by the onlyOwner modifier guarding setBaseTokenURI
changeName calls validateName to verify the proposed name
mintNFT writes _mintedBeforeReveal when minting before the reveal timestamp
_safeMint invokes _mint to actually create the token
mintNFT assigns startingIndexBlock when supply is exhausted or reveal time passes
mintIndex local derived from totalSupply is used as the minted token id in mintNFT
transferOwnership updates the privileged _owner state variable

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfNfts parameter is only consumed inside mintNFT for mint count and price checks
tokenId parameter is primarily consumed by changeName for the owner authorization check
newName parameter is only meaningful within the changeName flow
local balance is a transient snapshot used only by withdraw
local mintIndex is a loop temporary belonging only to mintNFT
local currentSupply is a transient value only used by getNFTPrice
newOwner parameter is only consumed by transferOwnership
